reviews.title: The Best Dual Monitor Mount I've Used—I Bought Six for My Office
reviews.body: After using one of these monitor mounts, I ended up buying six of them for my office. That alone should say how satisfied I am with the quality and performance. The instructions were easy to follow, and each mount felt solid as soon as it was installed. I have them supporting a variety of monitor sizes, and they've held everything securely without drifting or sagging over time.The range of adjustment is one of the biggest advantages. Being able to raise, lower, tilt, swivel, and rotate each monitor independently makes it easy to create an ergonomic workspace. Whether you're working long hours, sharing your screen with someone, or switching between landscape and portrait mode, the arms move smoothly and stay exactly where you position them.The build quality is excellent. The arms feel sturdy, the joints hold their tension well, and the overall construction gives you confidence that they'll stand up to daily use. Even after months of constant adjustments in an office environment, they continue to operate smoothly and keep the monitors firmly in place.Another benefit is how much desk space these mounts free up. Removing the factory monitor stands made every workstation look cleaner and gave us much more usable workspace for keyboards, paperwork, and other equipment. The built-in cable management also helps keep everything looking neat and professional.Overall, this has been one of the best office upgrades we've made. The combination of durability, smooth adjustability, excellent stability, and professional appearance makes these an outstanding value. Since I've purchased six of them for our office and would gladly buy more in the future, I can confidently recommend them to anyone looking for a dependable dual monitor mount.

reviews.title: Great dual monitor mount, but you may need to find a workaround for LG monitors
reviews.body: These are great and the assembly is fairly easy. The provided instructions are great and you have the option to clamp this to the side of the desk or secure it through an existing hole if there is one.I am using this with two 32" LG monitors. That's where I ran into a little snag. The place where the mount would be attached is recessed. The short screws wouldn't allow enough clearance for the hangers to work and the large screws (with plastic spacers) were too long. So either I needed shorter screws so I could use the provided 30mm screws or shorter spacers to use with the shorter 12mm screws to get just enough clearance. Finding spacers was actually the more difficult task and luckily Lowe's had a 12-pack of M4 25mm screws for just 3 bucks. These worked out perfectly and the end result looks really good. I was able to adjust the arms well enough that they wouldn't take up too much space behind the desk.Overall, I am very happy with this dual monitor setup and there is no need to deduct a star as I had a quick solution. But it would be nice if Huanuo could include the perfect spacer to bridge the gap for all monitors with a recessed mounting position.

features: Weight Capacity Upgrade: Crafted with aerospace-grade aluminum alloy and excellent design, our HUANUO dual monitor stand can support up to 22 lbs on each arm with rock-solid stability. Mount your monitors with peace of mind knowing they will remain steadily in place without sag or wobble.

Fits Large 32″ Monitors: Our computer monitor stand for desk fits most 17″–32″ flat or curved monitors with 75x75 or 100x100mm VESA mounting patterns. Displays can be easily mounted by attaching the VESA plates to the monitors, hanging on monitor arms, then securing with tightening knobs.

Customizable Viewing Angle: This dual monitor arm features +/-90° swivel to direct the screen toward your position, +90°/-35° tilt to help reduce glare, and 360° rotation to choose landscape or portrait mode. The dynamic screen positioning allows you to find the perfect viewing angle for both of your screens.

Flexible Arm Adjustment: Extend screens out 17.5″ by simply pulling them closer and raise the arms up to 17.5″ above the desktop by adjusting tension. Enjoy ergonomic viewing with screens that are positioned closer to eye level while freeing up valuable space on your desktop.

No-brainer: Choose C-clamp mounting for desks with 0.39″ to 2.56″ thickness or opt for grommet hole mounting for desks with 0.39″ to 2.17″ thickness. This monitor stands for 2 monitors Get set up in just 10 minutes with the included tools and instructions. It’s so easy, even your cat could do it (though we don’t recommend it).
